name: 98003 · Federal Way, WA
findings: ZIP 98003 (Federal Way) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98003 (Federal Way) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98003 (Federal Way) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
